title: Ordered interfacial domain expansion catalysis enhances hydrogen evolution for proton exchange membrane electrolysis
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00441A, Paper
Ming-Rong Qu, Yu-Xiao Cheng, Si-Hua Feng, Jie Xu, Jia-Kang Yao, Wen-Sheng Yan, Sheng Zhu, Liang Cao, Rui Wu, Shu-Hong Yu
An ordered interfacial domain expansion catalysis (OIDEC) mechanism is proposed to enhance HER on Pt/B–WO2.9 by decoupling the Volmer and Tafel steps, thereby accelerating reaction kinetics and improving Pt group metal utilization.
